sentences.zh: 总统乔·拜登刚刚宣布退出2024年总统竞选。

sentences.en: Just moments ago, the president tweeted out, it has been the greatest honor of my life to serve as your president.

sentences.en: Today, Peter Baker on how the race for the White House has suddenly been turned upside down.
sentences.zh: 今天，彼得·贝克将为您讲述白宫争夺战是如何突然发生天翻地覆的变化的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, July 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月22日，星期一。

sentences.en: Peter, good evening.
sentences.zh: 彼得，晚上好。

sentences.en: It's 7 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是下午7点。

sentences.en: Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 周日晚上。

sentences.en: We are all still catching our breaths and processing this news.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人仍在屏息凝神，消化这条消息。

sentences.en: But you bring a special set of credentials to this moment.
sentences.zh: 但在这个时刻，你有着独特的资质。

sentences.en: You're not just the chief White House correspondent for The Times.
sentences.zh: 你不仅是《时报》的白宫首席记者。

sentences.en: You're a historian of the presidency and of American politics.
sentences.zh: 你还是研究总统职位和美国政治的历史学家。

sentences.en: And so in that context, I very much want to understand your reaction to what happened a little before 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这样的背景下，我非常想了解你对今天下午

sentences.en: this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 快2点时发生的事情有何反应。

sentences.en: Yeah, Michael, there's literally no historical precedent for this.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，这在历史上简直没有先例。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 完全没有。

sentences.en: Nothing comes close.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能与之相比。

sentences.en: And I say that because no sitting president has dropped out of a race so late in the election cycle in American history.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因为，在美国历史上，从来没有现任总统在选举周期的这么晚阶段退出竞选。

sentences.en: I mean, it just doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这种事根本不会发生。

sentences.en: And the closest you can come to this is Lyndon Johnson, who dropped out in 1968.
sentences.zh: 你能想到的最接近的例子是林登·约翰逊，他在1968年退出了竞选。

sentences.en: It was a surprise like this in a way.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这也是一个惊喜。

sentences.en: But it was in March of that year when they were still having primaries.
sentences.zh: 但那是在那一年的3月，当时他们还在进行初选。

sentences.en: They hadn't yet gotten to this point where the primaries were over and about to have a convention and four months in an election year.
sentences.zh: 当时还没有走到初选结束、即将召开党代会、距离大选年还有四个月的这个阶段。

sentences.en: That's a political lifetime.
sentences.zh: 在政治上，四年——不对，四个月就像是一生那么长。

sentences.en: So this is very new and very much uncharted territory.
sentences.zh: 所以这是非常新鲜且绝对未知的领域。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I don't know where you were when you heard the news, but I was at a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我不知道听到消息时你在哪里，而我当时在一家餐馆里。

sentences.en: The people around me, when they learned it, gasped out loud, clutched their phones, were deeply surprised, and it clearly rocked them.
sentences.zh: 我身边的人得知这个消息时，都倒吸了一口气，紧紧抓住手机，深感震惊，这显然震动了他们。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: When we first saw the online message, the first reaction that we had was, is this real or is a fake?

sentences.en: We didn't hit the done button until we confirmed with two White House officials that it was for real because, you know, we didn't expect if he was going to do it, it would be just
sentences.zh: 直到我们向两位白宫官员证实这确实是真的，我们才点击发布按钮，因为你知道，我们没想到如果他真要这么做，会

sentences.en: like that on an online posting.

sentences.en: But he decided that was the best way to go.
sentences.zh: 但他认为这是最好的方式。

sentences.en: And he's got COVID, so he couldn't do it, apparently, in front of a camera without being raspy and coughing and so forth.

sentences.en: But it was a shock to everybody.
sentences.zh: 但这让所有人都感到震惊。

sentences.en: Well, there are so many dimensions of this that I want to cover with you, including the way in which he made this announcement, his subsequent endorsement, whether or not this

sentences.en: But first, I want to understand how exactly Biden came to this decision.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我想了解拜登究竟是如何做出这个决定。

sentences.en: Because, Peter, we left our listeners on Friday with the understanding that party leaders were waging a campaign to drive Biden out of the race.
sentences.zh: 因为，彼得，我们上周五给听众留下的印象是，党内领袖们正在发起一场将拜登挤出竞选的运动。

sentences.en: But you, along with some of our colleagues, had found that it was infuriating Biden, this effort to oust him by senior leaders, and it was making him want to dig in further.
sentences.zh: 但你和我们的一些同事发现，高层领袖们将他逼出局的努力激怒了拜登，这让他想要更顽强地坚守下去。

sentences.en: What happened in what seems like a very short window of time where he was choosing between, you know, bucking his party and swallowing a lot of pride and deciding to walk away?
sentences.zh: 在似乎如此短暂的时间窗口里，究竟发生了什么，让他从“对抗党内反对、强咽下这口傲气”转变为决定抽身离去？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's been isolated in Rehoboth Beach, his vacation house, since Wednesday night.
sentences.zh: 自周三晚上以来，他一直被隔离在他的度假屋——里霍博夫海滩。

sentences.en: He's been coughing and unhappy, obviously, as anybody would be when they're sick, but also bristling, like you said, against the people who he thought were his friends and
sentences.zh: 他一直在咳嗽，显然很不高兴，就像任何生病的人一样，但正如你所说，他也对那些他曾认为是朋友和

sentences.en: allies in a way, people like Nancy Pelosi and Barack Obama, who he perceived to be, as he saw it anyway, running a kind of semi-surreptitious campaign to drive him out.
sentences.zh: 盟友的人感到恼火，比如南希·佩洛西和巴拉克·奥巴马，在他看来，这些人正在暗中开展某种半隐秘的运动来将他逼出局。

sentences.en: And it was very hurtful, I think, as he saw it.
sentences.zh: 我想，在他看来，这非常伤人。

sentences.en: He was very upset about it.
sentences.zh: 对此他感到非常痛心。

sentences.en: He was mad about it.
sentences.zh: 他为此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And in fact, you know, just last night, I was talking with one of his closest people who said that he thought maybe he was actually starting to dig in more.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道，就在昨晚，我和他身边最亲近的人之一交谈过，那个人说他觉得拜登当时可能真的开始打算更坚决地抵抗了。

sentences.en: It was, in fact, going to resist all the pressure, even though it seemed like he was moving toward this kind of a conclusion.

sentences.en: And then the last 24 hours, it's been apparently a really dramatic period.
sentences.zh: 而在过去的24小时里，这显然是一个非常戏剧化的时期。

sentences.en: They thought that they would finally get a sense of where things were going and what was about to happen.
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己终于能弄清楚事情的走向以及即将发生什么。

sentences.en: And instead, they get this sort of routine report about the door knocking and the social media and all this and that that the campaign is doing.
sentences.zh: 然而取而代之的是，他们听到的是关于敲门拜访、社交媒体以及竞选团队正在做的诸如此类事情的例行汇报。

sentences.en: And half an hour in, a couple of them finally say, well, wait a second.
sentences.zh: 半小时后，其中几个人终于开口说，好吧，等一下。

sentences.en: We got to talk about the elephant in the room here.
sentences.zh: 我们必须谈谈这里显而易见却被刻意回避的大问题了。

sentences.en: The president's sick.

sentences.en: He doesn't want to announce it on camera if he sounds bad.
sentences.zh: 如果声音听起来很糟糕，他不想在镜头前宣布。

sentences.zh: 因此他们共同起草了这封信。

sentences.en: And this letter defends his presidency, talks about all the things they've accomplished, the things he's proud of, and then gets to the real punchline, which is that he's not

sentences.en: going to stand for re-election after all.
sentences.zh: 参加连任竞选。

sentences.en: Now, the president, at that point, hasn't told anybody this other than the people in that room, and they keep it secret.

sentences.en: And only on Sunday morning, after he slept on it, he finalizes the decision.

sentences.en: I'm backing out.

sentences.zh: 他在下午1点45分

sentences.zh: 在周日

sentences.en: A one-minute warning.
sentences.zh: 仅仅一分钟的警告。

sentences.zh: 直到点击按钮的前一刻，他们才被告知此事。

sentences.zh: 佩洛西、巴拉克·奥巴马和哈基姆·杰弗里斯——并没有支持卡玛拉·哈里斯，相反，他们似乎

sentences.zh: 我想知道你怎么看待这件事。

sentences.en: And that means if you're going to try to get this done in that time, there's very, very, very little window here, a very small window for anybody else to jump in.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果你想在这段时间内搞定这件事，留给其他任何人加入进来的窗口期都将非常非常小。

sentences.en: Peter, let's proceed down the path of Kamala Harris as heir apparent.
sentences.zh: 彼得，让我们顺着卡玛拉·哈里斯作为众望所归的继承人这条路往下探讨。

sentences.en: What are the logistics of her becoming the nominee and inheriting or recreating, if necessary, the apparatus of President Biden's reelection campaign and his financial war chest?
sentences.zh: 她成为提名人并继承或在必要时重组拜登总统连任竞选团队及其资金库的后勤工作是怎样的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, she has to be ratified by the roughly 4,000 delegates to the Democratic
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，她必须获得民主党大会大约4000名代表的正式批准，

sentences.en: Convention who are allowed to vote on a first ballot.
sentences.zh: 这些代表有资格在第一轮投票中进行表决。

sentences.en: Now, that could be a jump ball.
sentences.zh: 现在，这可能是一场充满变数的竞争。

sentences.en: But remember, those 4,000 delegates are almost all Biden delegates.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，那4000名代表几乎全部都是拜登的代表。

sentences.en: That means they're already sort of bought into the Biden-Harris ticket, and they're presumably less likely than Democrats generally to be open to other candidates.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们实际上已经接受了“拜登-哈里斯”组合，而且他们大概比普通民主党人更不容易接受其他候选人。

sentences.en: We don't know that for sure, but that's a guess, given that they're pledged to the president.
sentences.zh: 我们无法百分之百确定这一点，但这是一种猜测，鉴于他们原本是承诺支持总统的。

sentences.en: But she can't take anything for granted because we've never seen this in modern times.
sentences.zh: 但她不能把一切视为理所当然，因为我们在现代从未见过这种情况。

sentences.en: Then, once that happens, once she becomes the nominee, obviously, she has access to the apparatus of the reelection campaign.
sentences.zh: 然后，一旦这一切发生，一旦她成为提名人，显然她就能利用连任竞选团队的机构。

sentences.en: Because remember, her name is on the organization documents and all of that, too.
sentences.zh: 因为记住，组织文件上也有她的名字，诸如此类的一切都是如此。

sentences.en: It's the Biden-Harris campaign.
sentences.zh: 这是“拜登-哈里斯”竞选团队。

sentences.en: So she has a legal claim to the apparatus, to the war chest, and so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 所以她对这个机构、资金库等等拥有合法的继承权。

sentences.en: And it looks like the Biden people are telling friends and allies and staff that they're planning to be her team now as well.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来拜登团队的人正在告诉朋友、盟友和工作人员，他们现在也计划成为她的团队。

sentences.en: I just want to pause and reflect on the fact that we're talking about a set of logistics that were inconceivable just even a few hours ago, and now we're in the thick of them.
sentences.zh: 我只是想停下来思考这样一个事实：我们正在讨论的一套后勤安排在几个小时前还是不可想象的，而现在我们正身处其中。

sentences.en: And one of them is who is going to be the number two on a theoretical Harris ticket, because she has been the number two on this ticket until today.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是，在理论上的哈里斯竞选组合中，谁会成为二号人物，因为直到今天她一直都是这个组合的二号人物。

sentences.en: How do we think Kamala Harris is going to be thinking about that decision?
sentences.zh: 我们认为卡玛拉·哈里斯会如何看待这个决定？

sentences.en: And when does that decision come?
sentences.zh: 这个决定又会在什么时候做出？

sentences.en: Kamala Harris, traditionally, you don't pick a running mate until pretty much the convention.
sentences.zh: 传统上，卡玛拉·哈里斯直到大会召开前不久才会挑选竞选搭档。

sentences.en: Perhaps, though, she thinks she needs to pick a number two right now in order to seem like a strong nominee.
sentences.zh: 不过，她也许认为自己现在就需要挑选一个二号人物，以便看起来像一个强有力的提名人。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: We're jumping ahead from who's going to be number one to who's going to be number two, because there's really no time not to, right?
sentences.zh: 我们直接从谁是一号人物跳到了谁是二号人物，因为真的没有时间去犹豫，对吧？

sentences.en: And the party is focused on this, and she's focused on this.
sentences.zh: 党内正聚焦于此，她也聚焦于此。

sentences.en: And because she has been the loyal number two to President Biden all this time, she hasn't been able to do anything to prepare, right?
sentences.zh: 而且因为她一直以来都是拜登总统忠实的二号人物，她根本无法做任何准备工作，对吧？

sentences.en: There's been no official vetting going on.
sentences.zh: 没有任何官方的背景调查在进行。

sentences.en: There's been no official meetings held.
sentences.zh: 没有任何官方会议召开。

sentences.en: There's been no official interviews conducted.
sentences.zh: 没有任何官方采访进行。

sentences.en: So she has very little time to start thinking about this at the same time she's consolidating support for herself.
sentences.zh: 因此，在她为自己巩固支持的同时，她几乎没有时间开始考虑这件事。

sentences.en: But there is a lot of thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 不过关于这方面的思考确实有很多。

sentences.en: The idea is that she would have to balance out the ticket with somebody who would, you know, make up for any weaknesses she has.
sentences.zh: 大家的想法是，她必须用一个能够（你知道的）弥补她任何弱点的人来平衡这个组合。

sentences.en: There is a concern by a lot of Democrats about how she will play in some of these Midwestern

sentences.zh: 比如密歇根州、威斯康星州和宾夕法尼亚州，这些州对大选至关重要，在那里的白人工薪中产阶级中，

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Presumably, they're going to park J.D.
sentences.zh: 据推测，他们将在接下来的100天里把J·D·万斯“安插”在宾夕法尼亚州，让他真正利用邻近州的同理心之类的效应。

sentences.en: Vance in Pennsylvania for the next 100 days and really just have him play on the neighboring state solidarity kind of thing.

sentences.en: And he can appeal to some of these very voters we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否意味着她会选择例如目前宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗（Josh Shapiro）？

sentences.en: So does that mean she picks, for instance, a Josh Shapiro, who's the governor of Pennsylvania right now?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着她会选择像北卡罗来纳州州长罗伊·库珀（Roy Cooper）这样的人，或者肯塔基州州长安迪·贝希尔（Andy Beshear）？

sentences.en: Does it mean she picks somebody like Governor Roy Cooper, a governor of North Carolina, or Governor Annie Beshear of Kentucky, who may be not from the most important states, but
sentences.zh: 他们可能不是来自最重要的州，但被视为温和派，可能更容易被这些其他摇摆州的某些选民所接受？

sentences.en: are seen as moderates and maybe more acceptable to some of the voters in these other battleground states?
sentences.zh: 所以，这些就是你接下来会看到的权衡算计。

sentences.en: So those are the calculations you're going to see, I think, going forward.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，现在需要转变方向的不仅仅是她一个人。

sentences.en: And she's not the only one now who has to pivot, of course.
sentences.zh: 共和党人此前一直针对乔·拜登展开竞选，甚至自辩论以来就一直期待着这一天，现在他们不得不转变矛头去对付她。

sentences.en: The Republicans who had been running against Joe Biden and even kind of looking forward to it since the debate are now having to pivot to go after her.
sentences.zh: 但他们正摩拳擦掌、跃跃欲试，想要利用这一刻继续对拜登穷追猛打。

sentences.zh: 鉴于时间如此紧迫，他们在战略上是如何考虑这一点的？

sentences.zh: 正如你在广告前所说的那样，他们本来希望拜登留在竞选中的现实。

sentences.en: And you saw that from pretty high up Republicans, including Speaker Mike Johnson and Elise Stefanik, who's in the leadership.
sentences.zh: 这是一种挑起事端的方式。

sentences.en: And it's a way of stirring the pot.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种论证方式，旨在说明民主党有一个软弱的领导人，而且他们是一个陷入混乱的政党。

sentences.en: And it's a way of making the argument that Democrats have a weak leader and that they're a party in disarray.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，他们试图通过声称民主党总统不配当总统来诋毁整个民主党的品牌。

sentences.en: In a sense, they're trying to impugn the entire Democratic brand by saying that the Democratic president shouldn't be president.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是希望这种负面影响能够层层渗透，从而玷污卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: Well, Kamala Harris is 59.

sentences.zh: 所以，年龄问题不仅消失了，而且可能开始变成特朗普的问题吗？

sentences.en: So does the age thing not only go away but perhaps start to become a problem for Trump?
sentences.zh: 是的，事实上，这是一个罕见的例子，候选人的更换使一个政党能够将原本针对自己的论点反过来攻击另一个政党，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, actually, this is one of the rare instances where a change in Canada allows a party to turn the argument that worked against them around on the other party, right?
sentences.zh: 她现在将把那场代际之争完全引向特朗普，因为她会说他才是那个太老的人。

sentences.en: She's going to totally take that generational fight to Trump now because she's going to say he's the one who's too old.
sentences.zh: 他才是那个有认知问题的人。

sentences.en: He's the one who has cognitive probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他才是那个总是把名字混淆、把日期混淆、把诸如此类的事情搞混的人。

sentences.en: He's the one who keeps mixing up names and mixing up dates and mixing up things like that.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该让他再执政四年，因为他已经胜任不了这份工作了。

sentences.en: And that we should not allow him to be in office for another four years because he's not up to the job.
sentences.zh: 请帮我理解一下攻击哈里斯本人有什么计划。

sentences.en: Help me understand what the plan is to attack Harris herself.
sentences.zh: 很显然，鉴于对拜登的担忧，他们想把她和拜登捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: Clearly, they want to link her to Biden given the concerns about him.
sentences.zh: 但我们所理解的他们批判哈里斯的战略是什么？

sentences.en: But what do we understand to be their strategy for critiquing Harris?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 当他们攻击她时，他们试图把她描绘成一个极左翼分子，对吧？

sentences.en: And when they go after her, they try to paint her as a radical left-winger, right?
sentences.zh: 认为她比乔·拜登要激进得多。

sentences.en: That she's somehow much more on the fringe than Joe Biden is.
sentences.zh: 你看到总统的长子小唐纳德·特朗普在“真实社交”（Truth Social）上写道：

sentences.en: And you saw Donald Trump Jr., the president's oldest son, write on True Social.
sentences.zh: 他说，引述如下：

sentences.en: He said, quote,
sentences.zh: “卡玛拉·哈里斯承袭了乔·拜登全部的极左翼政策记录。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris owns the entire left-wing policy record of Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 唯一的区别是她比乔更加自由派、更加无能，这真可以说是前所未闻了。”

sentences.en: The only difference is that she's even more liberal and less competent than Joe, which is really saying something.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一战略不仅是将卡玛拉·哈里斯作为软弱领导人与拜登绑定，并希望这种印象能从他身上转移到她身上，

sentences.en: So the strategy isn't just to attach Kamala Harris to Biden as a weak leader and hope that that kind of transfers from him to her.
sentences.zh: 而且还要暗示她是一个左翼激进分子。

sentences.en: But in addition to suggest that she is a left-wing radical.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我觉得这完全说准了。

sentences.en: Hey, I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，这种论点有点棘手，因为她至少在民主党人眼里并不被认为特别自由派。

sentences.en: But in fact, the argument is kind of a tricky one because she is not seen, at least by Democrats, as being especially liberal.
sentences.zh: 她曾在加利福尼亚州担任检察官。

sentences.en: She was a prosecutor in California.
sentences.zh: 事实上，2020年她竞选总统时，一些自由派并不喜欢她，因为她太温和了。

sentences.en: In fact, some of the liberals when she ran for president in 2020 didn't like her because she was too moderate.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，

sentences.en: In their view.
sentences.zh: 比如说，对犯罪打击过于严厉。

sentences.en: Too tough on crime, for instance.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正试图把她描绘成一个激进分子。

sentences.en: So they're trying to paint her as a radical.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，一些民主党人会认为这在一定程度上是刻板印象造成的。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, some Democrats would argue that's a function partly of stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 但她必须应对这一点，向公众阐明她真正的政治理念是什么，并为卡玛拉·哈里斯本人——而不是乔·拜登——进行自我定义。

sentences.en: But she'll have to contend with that and make out to the public what she really thinks her philosophy is and define herself for who Kamala Harris is, not Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果卡玛拉·哈里斯成为提名人，现在将有太多的问题来定义这场竞选。

sentences.en: I mean, there are so many questions that will now define this race if Kamala Harris is the nominee.
sentences.zh: 仅举其中几个例子，考虑到特朗普过去有时会发表公开的种族主义言论，让一位有色人种女性与特朗普对决意味着什么？

sentences.en: And just to hint at some of them, what does it mean to have a woman of color running against Trump, given his history of sometimes openly racist comments?
sentences.zh: 让前检察官对阵被定罪的重罪犯意味着什么？

sentences.en: What does it mean to have a former prosecutor taking on a convicted felon?
sentences.zh: 哈里斯会不会像我们所讨论的那样，被认为与拜登绑定太深，以至于无法在这场竞选中代表任何意义上的彻底决裂？

sentences.en: Is it going to feel like Harris is, as we've talked about, far too attached to Biden to represent anything approaching a clean break in this race?
sentences.zh: 那些一直困扰她作为副总统的旧有问题——即她似乎永远无法在这个政府中完全找到自己的立足点和位置——

sentences.en: And will the same issues that dogged her as vice president, which is that she would never quite seem to find her footing and her place in this administration,
sentences.zh: 会成为她竞选的故事主线吗？

sentences.en: become the story of her campaign?
sentences.zh: 还是说存在这样一种非常现实的可能性：在很短的时间内，她的人气会急剧飙升，因为太多的选民一直极度渴望看到拜登和特朗普之外的任何替代人选？

sentences.en: Or is there just a very real possibility that in a short time period, she catches fire because so many voters have been desperate for any alternative to both Biden and Trump?
sentences.zh: 我知道这向你抛出了很多问题，但我认为这些正是将定义未来几周走向的问题。

sentences.en: And I know that's a lot of questions to throw at you, but I think those are the questions that are going to define the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 哦，迈克尔，你会成为一名伟大的白宫记者的。

sentences.en: Oh, Michael, you'd be a great White House reporter.
sentences.zh: 这完全就是我们向总统提问的方式。

sentences.en: This is exactly the way we ask the questions of the president.
sentences.zh: 先生，让我把为您准备的那五个问题提出来吧。

sentences.en: Let me give you the five questions I got for you, sir.
sentences.zh: 但你是对的。

sentences.en: But you're right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些都是正确的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, there's all the right questions, right?
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们不知道答案，因为我们正身处一个未曾涉足的领域。

sentences.en: And the truth is we don't know the answer because we are in an area we haven't been before.
sentences.zh: 这将是令人瞩目的三个半月，我们将拭目以待答案究竟是什么。

sentences.en: And it's going to be a remarkable three and a half months to find out what the answers are.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她有相当大的可能会给选民带来一张全新的面孔，因为他们对这两位候选人——拜登和特朗普——都太厌烦了。

sentences.en: I think there's a decent chance that she does offer voters a fresh face because they are so sick of both these candidates, Biden and Trump.
sentences.zh: 民调非常清楚地表明，坦率地说，选民甚至包括他们自己党内的成员，都不想和这两人中的任何一个沾上边。

sentences.en: The polls have made very clear that voters wanted nothing to do with either of them, frankly, even members of their own party.
sentences.zh: 最终，你得到了他们一直说他们想要的东西：一个来自新一代的全新面孔。

sentences.en: Finally, you have what they say they want, which is a fresh face from a new generation.
sentences.zh: 最终，你得到了他们一直说他们想要的东西：一个来自新一代的全新面孔。

sentences.en: Now, that doesn't mean she can turn it into support necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不过，这并不意味着她必然能把这转化为支持率。

sentences.en: She's going to have to convince the public that she's up for the job and that they really will get something that they want from her.
sentences.zh: 她必须让公众确信她能胜任这份工作，并且他们确实能从她这里得到想要的东西。

sentences.en: I think you're right to say that she has struggled in the past with her own campaigns.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你说得对，她过去在自己的竞选活动中确实步履维艰。

sentences.en: Her own campaign for president in 2020 died on the vine.
sentences.zh: 她在2020年的总统竞选还没开始就夭折了。

sentences.en: She didn't even make it to the first vote, but she has some opportunities here, and she can reintroduce herself to the public, and we'll see how she does.
sentences.zh: 她甚至没坚持到初选投票，但她现在有一些机会，她可以向公众重新介绍自己，我们拭目以待她的表现。

sentences.en: And one last thing is you mentioned the part about a former prosecutor taking on a convicted felon.
sentences.zh: 还有最后一件事，你刚才提到了前检察官对阵被定罪的重罪犯这一段。

sentences.en: That could be really interesting.
sentences.zh: 那可能会非常有趣。

sentences.en: She sees herself more than anything as a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 她首先将自己视为一名检察官。

sentences.en: That's her self-image.
sentences.zh: 那是她的自我认知。

sentences.en: Her self-image is a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 她的自我认知就是检察官。

sentences.en: And to watch the two of them on stage, assuming he agrees to still do a debate with her, could be really interesting to watch.
sentences.zh: 而且看他们两人同台——假设他仍然同意与她辩论——一定会非常有趣。

sentences.en: We are rightfully, I think, focused on what the future of this race looks like now that Biden is out, and it looks like it's going to possibly be Harris versus Trump.
sentences.zh: 我认为，随着拜登退选，我们把焦点放在这场竞选的未来走向是理所应当的，看起来很可能是哈里斯对阵特朗普。

sentences.en: But, Peter, to end, I want to talk about Biden's place in history given what he just did a few hours ago.
sentences.zh: 但是，彼得，最后我想谈谈拜登在历史上的地位，考虑到他几个小时前刚做的那件事。

sentences.en: He, from all you have written, dreaded this moment.
sentences.zh: 根据你所写的一切，他一直很害怕这个时刻。

sentences.en: He didn't want to be a one-term president.
sentences.zh: 他不想只当一届总统。

sentences.en: He believes his presidency was a success because of the list of bipartisan legislation that he passed on everything from infrastructure to climate,
sentences.zh: 他认为他的总统任期是成功的，因为他通过了一系列两党立法，涵盖了从基础设施到气候的方方面面，

sentences.en: which were historic pieces of legislation.
sentences.zh: 这些都是具有历史意义的立法。

sentences.en: And clearly he believes that all the external signs of his aging don't match the reality of his competence, but the rest of the party just doesn't agree with him,
sentences.zh: 显然，他认为他衰老的所有外在表象并不符合他实际的工作能力，但党内其他人并不同意他的看法，

sentences.en: and the polls don't seem to agree with him either.
sentences.zh: 民调似乎也并不赞同他。

sentences.en: I just want to sit for a minute with the idea of how this decision fits into the larger question of how we're going to be thinking about Joe Biden in four years, eight years,
sentences.zh: 我只想花点时间思考一下，这个决定如何契合一个更宏大的问题：我们在四年、八年、

sentences.en: 12 years, 50 years.
sentences.zh: 12年、50年后会如何看待乔·拜登。

sentences.en: I think that's a great question because, in fact, that was at the heart of the conversation over the last three weeks.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个很好的问题，因为事实上，这也是过去三周对话的核心所在。

sentences.en: Not just could he win, but how would history remember him?
sentences.zh: 不仅是他能否获胜，还有历史会如何记住他？

sentences.en: For him, this is an excruciating decision.
sentences.zh: 对他而言，这是一个极其痛苦的决定。

sentences.en: It fought against every instinct he has.
sentences.zh: 这违背了他所有的直觉。

sentences.en: Remember, he's been in politics for a half century, and every time somebody said, no, Joe, you can't do that, he often did it anyway and often succeeded.
sentences.zh: 记住，他从政半个世纪了，每当有人说，不，乔，你不能那样做，他往往还是去做了，并且经常成功。

sentences.en: In his mind, anyway, his self-image is somebody who overcame all the doubters and the skeptics and the people who didn't believe in him, the people who denigrated him.
sentences.zh: 至少在他自认为的脑海中，他的自我形象是一个战胜了所有怀疑者、悲观主义者、不相信他的人以及贬低他的人的人。

sentences.en: And to give in to that pressure was, you know, I think, searing for him.
sentences.zh: 而向这种压力妥协，你知道的，我认为对他来说无异于剜心刺骨。

sentences.en: But part of the argument is you will be remembered kindly by history for putting country ahead of yourself.
sentences.zh: 但部分辩护理由是，你把国家置于自身之上，历史会因此而仁慈地记住你。

sentences.en: And that's why you saw these Democrats racing out today to lionize him over this decision,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你看到这些民主党人今天争先恐后地因为这个决定而将他奉为英雄，

sentences.en: including former President Obama and former Speaker Pelosi and all these others saying that he will be remembered for his grace and courage and self-sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 包括前总统奥巴马、前众议院议长佩洛西以及所有其他人，他们都说他将因其优雅、勇气和自我牺牲而被人们铭记。

sentences.en: Obviously, that's to soften the blow, but also I think maybe they believe it, and I think that that's important for Biden's place in history.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是为了缓和打击，但我也认为也许他们是真心相信的，而且我认为这对拜登在历史上的地位很重要。

sentences.en: But the last thing I would say on this is because it happened so late, it still means the result of the election is going to play into how he's remembered in the history books.
sentences.zh: 但关于这一点我最后要说的是，因为这件事发生得太晚了，这就意味着选举结果仍然会影响他在历史书中的形象。

sentences.en: If Kamala Harris loses, a lot of people will still say that was Biden's fault for waiting so long.
sentences.zh: 如果卡玛拉·哈里斯输了，很多人仍然会说那是拜登等得太久的错。

sentences.en: If she wins, he will be validated for having made this decision that he's made now to step aside, and he will be remembered more kindly.
sentences.zh: 如果她赢了，他现在做出退让的决定将得到历史的验证，他也会被更宽容地记住。

sentences.en: So this is a problem for presidents, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这对总统来说是个难题，对吧？

sentences.en: History is always waiting, and they're always focused on what it will say, and you can't rewrite it once it's happened.
sentences.zh: 历史总是在等待，他们总是关注历史会怎么说，一旦事情发生，你就无法重写。

sentences.en: Well, Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，彼得，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们深表感激。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: On Sunday, my colleagues asked Democratic voters to reflect on Biden's decision, his endorsement of Harris, and what it will mean for the final weeks of the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 周日，我的同事请民主党选民反思拜登的决定、他对哈里斯的背书，以及这对总统大选最后几周意味着什么。

sentences.en: So what was your reaction to the news about President Biden today?
sentences.zh: 那么，你对今天关于拜登总统的消息有什么反应？

sentences.en: I was relieved.
sentences.zh: 我松了一口气。

sentences.en: He's been a great president, but it was time for new leadership in the party.
sentences.zh: 他是一位伟大的总统，但党内确实需要新的领导层了。

sentences.en: I think he did the most patriotic thing I've seen a president do.
sentences.zh: 我认为他做出了我见过的总统所能做出的最具爱国主义精神的事。

sentences.en: He sacrificed his political future for the good of the country.
sentences.zh: 为了国家的利益，他牺牲了自己的政治前途。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm a little choked up.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我有点哽咽。

sentences.en: I cried because I love Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我哭了，因为我爱乔·拜登。

sentences.en: I absolutely love Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常爱乔·拜登。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: Still can't talk about Joe Biden without feeling like I'm going to cry, and I am really proud.
sentences.zh: 提到乔·拜登还是会让我感觉快要哭出来，我真的感到很骄傲。

sentences.en: After the debate, it was scary.
sentences.zh: 辩论之后，情况太吓人了。

sentences.en: I don't think I want that guy in the office, and we need somebody stronger.
sentences.zh: 我不想让那种人当政，我们需要更强大的人。

sentences.en: I think Kamala is going to run, and I think that I hope she's got to go at it.
sentences.zh: 我认为卡玛拉会参选，而且我认为我希望她能全力以赴。

sentences.en: I don't think Kamala has been around long enough.
sentences.zh: 我觉得卡玛拉从政的时间还不够长。

sentences.en: It's really sad and scary to say, but I don't think the middle of the country is going to vote for a female and one who is a minority.
sentences.zh: 说这话真的很悲哀也很吓人，但我认为美国中部地区不会投票给女性，更不会投票给少数族裔女性。

sentences.en: Honestly, I don't really think that Harris will do well nationwide.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我真的不认为哈里斯在全国范围内能表现得很好。

sentences.en: And you're saying that as a black woman yourself?
sentences.zh: 你作为一名黑人女性，也这么认为吗？

sentences.en: As a black woman, yeah, I am.
sentences.zh: 作为一名黑人女性，是的，我确实这么认为。

sentences.en: America's just not ready for a woman president, especially not a black woman president.
sentences.zh: 美国根本还没准备好迎接一位女总统，尤其是黑人女总统。

sentences.en: We're going to see more people kind of perk up and say, all right, we have another good, strong woman who was a prosecutor, and she's going to run against a criminal.
sentences.zh: 我们会看到更多人振作起来说，好吧，我们有另一位优秀的、坚强的、当过检察官的女性，她将与一个罪犯竞选。

sentences.en: This is going to make a great story.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个精彩的故事。

sentences.en: I just hope now that people will rally behind Kamala and not have a big fight on the floor for the convention coming up.
sentences.zh: 我只希望现在人们能团结在卡玛拉身后，不要在即将到来的党代会上大吵大闹。

sentences.en: So we need to get it settled and get to the business of beating Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要敲定此事，开始全力以赴击败特朗普。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The director of the Secret Service is now facing bipartisan calls to resign
sentences.zh: 特勤局局长目前正面临两党要求其辞职的呼声，

sentences.en: after the agency acknowledged that it repeatedly denied requests for additional resources sought by Donald Trump's security detail.
sentences.zh: 此前该机构承认，其一再拒绝了唐纳德·特朗普安保团队寻求额外资源的请求。

sentences.en: The requests for more security were sought throughout the past two years, but were not specifically for the rally where Trump was shot.
sentences.zh: 增加安保的请求在过去两年中一直存在，但并非专门针对特朗普遭到枪击的那场集会。

sentences.en: Even so, the revelation is fueling criticism of Secret Service director Kimberly Cheadle, who is scheduled to appear before Congress later today.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这一爆料还是加剧了对特勤局局长金伯利·切蒂尔的批评，她计划于今天晚些时候出席国会听证会。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Jessica Chung, Shannon Lin, and Sydney Harper, with help from Olivia Natt and Carlos Prieto.

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡觉会不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症、食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
